subject: POC kickstart: aligning owners, timeline & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearwave.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: POC kickstart: aligning owners, timeline & acceptance checklist

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock the POC kickstart meeting so all stakeholders can align on success criteria, owners, and the timeline. Suggested goals for the 60-minute session: 

- Confirm success criteria (functional + performance + security acceptance)
- Assign owners for integration, test data & validation, procurement sign-off, and post-POC evaluation
- Agree on timeline/milestones and rollback/fallback plan

Proposed blocks (PST):
- Wed Aug 18, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Aug 19, 14:00–15:00
- Fri Aug 20, 09:00–10:00

Please confirm which slot works for you and who from ClearWave should join. I'm cc'ing Dev (SE) for technical agenda items, Marissa for success criteria and customer ops, and Mina for security artifacts.

Attached: POC-success-criteria-draft.pdf — a short draft of acceptance items to review during the call.

If procurement/legal need to be on the call, let us know — we can also run a separate procurement checklist meeting if that helps speed approvals.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: POC-success-criteria-draft.pdf (PDF, 24KB)

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearwave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickstart: aligning owners, timeline & acceptance checklist

Hannah —

Thanks, that looks good. We can do Thu Aug 19 14:00–15:00 ET (which I think is Thu 11:00–12:00 PT).

Attendees from our side so far: myself (Product Lead), Maya Singh (Procurement), and Diego Alvarez (Platform Engineer). Our security lead (rachel.security@clearwave.com) needs the security checklist and may not join the first hour but will review the artifacts.

Quick note on procurement: Maya will need a brief pre-call with Marissa to walk terms and the payment timeline — Maya's availability is Mon/Tue mornings next week. Can Marissa and I get a 20-min slot?

Agenda request: could Dev include a 10-minute walk-through of the integration touchpoints and a 10-minute demo of expected latency under a small test harness? That will help us validate acceptance criteria quickly.

Appreciate the draft criteria — I'll review and send any redlines by Monday.

Cheers,
Alex

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearwave.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickstart: aligning owners, timeline & acceptance checklist

Alex / Hannah —

Confirmed on our side: Thu Aug 19 11:00–12:00 PT works for the engineering team. I'll plan the following 60-min breakout: 

- 5m quick intros & scope
- 10m integration touchpoints (auth, data flow, expected token sizes)
- 10m demo of baseline latency with a 50-concurrent-session harness (what we showed in the demo)
- 20m live run of a small synthetic dataset and validation steps
- 15m acceptance criteria walkthrough + next steps

Action items before the call: 
- ClearWave: share sample test data (anonymized) and an IP range allowlist for any on-prem agents
- Redwood: share a minimal test harness repo and the perf run script (I'll post the link to the shared doc)

Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Gxq7r-example-poc-plan (seating chart + runbook)

Thanks — I attached a short tech checklist to help security/procurement triage.

-Dev

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: tech-prep-checklist.txt (TXT, 3KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearwave.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: POC kickstart: aligning owners, timeline & acceptance checklist

Hannah / Alex —

Looping in the Redwood security checklist so ClearWave's security lead can confirm timelines. For a clean POC start we need the following artifacts at least 48 hours before the kickoff: 

- Completed security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (controls mapping + responsible owners)
- Network allowlist and test IPs
- Data retention scoping (what stays in cache, what is logged)

I've attached the spreadsheet template; OpenWave (sic) can fill the right-hand column with their owner names. If the security lead can't attend the first hour, we still need the completed checklist to move forward.

Attachment: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
